This antenna array not only maintains the advantages of the traditional waveguide slot antenna array, but also has the characteristics of wide bandwidth. The measurements show that the radiating efficiency of the CP-DCWS antenna array is 80%, which is almost the same as the traditional waveguide slot antenna array, and the bandwidth of the CP-DCWS antenna array is 700 MHz, which is 200 MHz (40%) wider than the traditional waveguide slot array antenna. Measured results are in good agreement with electromagnetic simulations.

articleTitle: Design of the absorber screen based on the modified bow-tie patch periodical array
abstract: A single layer absorber screen is proposed in this paper, which has the much thinner depth and wider band compared with Salisbury screen. The absorber is composed of metallic periodical arrays and the lumped resistors on the substrate. In the periodical unit, the size is reduced intentionally to avoid the reflection of high Floquent's modes. However, this reduction is disadvantageous to the resonant of metallic patches at the lower frequency. Then, the capacitive loading technique in antenna engineering is extended to the design for absorber, and at the same time, the bow-tie patches are adopted here to increase the bandwidth. To obtain the wider bandwidth, the modified bow-tie patches with different size are designed in one unit to make the absorber resonant at multiple frequencies. Finally, the simulation result shows that the absorber screen proposed in this paper has an 86% wide band for -10dB power reflection and the depth of absorber is nearly 1/8 of the wavelength at the center frequency in free space.

articleTitle: The analysis of ion line spectra induced by powerful heating
abstract: The disturbance amplitude of ion line spectra can reach 1~600 in the heating experiment, and the enhancement structure almost continues all the heating time, which can't be explained by parameter instability, though it can give an explanation for enhancement structure qualitatively in very short time. Almost all the abnormity spectra structure are double-humped anisomerous composed by coherent echo single-humped and incoherent echo double-humped. Through extracting and dealing with the coherent structure, we get the coherent echo single-humped, and find that the coherent echo is dominating.

articleTitle: The simulation research of ionospheric side-scatter ionogram
abstract: Studies on ionospheric side-scatter are of great significance to MIMO OTHR. The side-scatter ionogram includes most information of side-scatter channel characteristics. Thus, the simulations of ionospheric side-scatter ionogram are developed in order to give a preliminary understanding of the side-scatter propagation, then the preliminary results are given.

articleTitle: EMC pre-design research based on system engineering approach
abstract: Nowadays electronic, electrical equipments are more and more intensive, which means that the quantitative analysis of a system has became increasingly complex, and it makes the introduction of systems engineering approach for qualitative analysis to be a trend in the field of electromagnetic compatibility. The main systems engineering approach in the field of electromagnetic compatibility is the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and its various derivative algorithms. It is only applied to electromagnetic compatibility assessment of the EMC basic design, but little reference value for EMC pre-design. For electromagnetic compatibility characteristics of the study, we use the combination of `decision making trial and evaluation laboratory' and `interpretation of the structure model' to analyse the problem of electromagnetic compatibility. A new systems engineering approach applicable to electromagnetic compatibility pre-design, EMCSAM, is proposed. An example is presented to prove the feasibility and efficiency of the new method.

articleTitle: Profiling atmospheric temperature using temperature weighting functions
abstract: The weighting functions are the foundation for understanding the reversion of the atmospheric profiles by ground-based radiometer. This article has analyzed the principle and the feature of microwave sensing of the atmospheric temperature profiles. The temperature weighting functions are calculated and analyzed by the atmospheric radiation transfer equation and atmospheric profiles obtained by radiosonde. The results can be used for the selection of the working frequencies of ground-based radiometer in atmospheric remote sensing.

articleTitle: Plate end-fire antenna design based on genetic algorithm
abstract: A modified genetic algorithm (GA) is used to design plate end-fire-antennas. Six kinds of new plate end-fire antennas with ten monopoles each have been designed, in which the parasitic monopoles and broadband structure have been used. Compared with the antenna designed by the Hansen-Wood yard condition, the feeding characteristics of the antennas have been improved remarkably and then the gain has been increased accordingly, while the directivity of the antennas with new structure has been kept at the same level.

articleTitle: A method for omni-directional radiating SLF radio signal based on grounded antenna
abstract: In order to solving the problem of extremely low efficiency for radiating SLF signal, in this paper we study a method of antenna designing based on grounded antenna and analysis the direction characteristic of the grounded antenna. Using this design method, the SLF antenna has the shortest size and the highest efficiency. Because the grounded antenna has the direction characteristics, the reliability of underwater mobile platform communication that use one grounded antenna is not consistent in different waters. Therefore, in this paper a method of omni-directional radiating SLF signal is presented. According to this method, the SLF antenna array is built with two orthogonal grounded antennas. By controlling the phase difference of two orthogonal antennas' input current, we can make the synthetic electric field strength that the antenna array radiates equal and uniformity in all horizontal direction, so we can realize the SLF signal to omni-directional and equal power radiating. This method is simple and easy to apply to underwater SLF communication, but the control of current phase difference must be accurately. Using this method we can significantly improve the reliability of SLF communication. It is very important to underwater mobile platform communication and underwater communication.

articleTitle: The use of curl-conforming basis functions for the magnetic-field integral equation with MLFMA algorithm
abstract: Divergence-conforming Rao-Wilton-Glisson(RWG) functions are commonly used in integral equations to model the surface current distributions on planar triangulations. In this paper, a novel implementation of the magnetic-filed integral equation (MFIE) employing the curl-conforming n×RWG basis functions and testing functions is introduced to improve the current modeling. Implementation details are outlined in the contexts of the moment of method, the method of MLFMA algorithm. Based on the examples of electromagnetic modeling of perfect electrical conducting scatterers, It is demonstrated that significant improvement in the accuracy of the MFIE can be obtained by using the curl-conforming n×RWG functions.

articleTitle: Near-surface electromagnetic fields for a chiral cylinder perpendicularly illuminated with an on-axis Gaussian beam
abstract: An analytical solution is presented to compute the field distribution near a chiral cylinder surface at normal incidence of an on-axis Gaussian beam. The theoretical analysis of the scattering problem is complicated due to the fact that the left and right circularly polarized waves propagate in the chiral medium with different propagation constants. Numerical results for the normalized near-surface field intensity are given and discussed concisely.

articleTitle: Numerical study of the shielding effectiveness of a rectangular enclosure with elliptic apertures
abstract: This paper deals with the numerical analysis of the shielding effectiveness (SE) of enclosure with elliptic apertures in one face. Elliptic apertures are treated as a length of coplanar strip transmission line and the enclosure as rectangular waveguide. The shielding effectiveness of the enclosure are studied by Finite Integration Technique (FIT) over broad band (0-3GHz).

articleTitle: A delayed power-on switch designed for HMC609 application circuits
abstract: The HMC609 is a representative of RF amplifiers that demand a certain power up sequence. It is critical that its bias gate voltage must come before the power supply voltage Vdd. In this paper, we propose a novel switching circuit that can delay the arrival of power supply voltage, in order to obey the power up sequence. The working principle of this time-delay switch is based on the transient response of first order RC circuit and the switching characteristic of P-channel MOSFET. A simulation result of this circuit structure is given to verify the function of the designed switch. This design has obvious advantages over other common used measures of power management, and can be applied to many other models of amplifiers.

articleTitle: The analysis of HF-induced abnormal enhancement of plasma line
abstract: As an important characterization in ionospheric heating experiments, the disturbed plasma line have been widely studied. On November 23, 2011, a polar winter ionospheric heating experiment with the linearly varied heating frequency was carried out by China. In this experiment, a very interesting feature of HF-enhanced plasma line is observed. When the heating is on, the enhancement of plasma line is tens times larger than that of background in the first 8 minutes. Then the enhancement increases rapidly, and the increase rate can reach thousands or even tens of thousands times. Based on the comparison of the ion acoustic frequency, heating frequency and the frequency of the maximum value of plasma line, and the analysis of the matching height of parametric instability and the matching height of n times gyro-frequency, we infer that the enhanced plasma line in this experiment may be induced by parametric instability and 5 times gyro-frequency resonance.

articleTitle: Study on the gain media using FDTD and four energy level model
abstract: In order to investigate the gain media which were widely used in metamaterial, a four energy level model is proposed. We solve three groups of coupled equations: Maxwell equations, rate equations of electronic population and polarization equation. Population inversion and lasing threshlod were observed using numerical experiments based on a novel finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) treatment of the optical field. These results show good agreement with lasing theories and our numerical model can be used as an efficient tool for pursuing novel laser devices.

articleTitle: Time domain adaptive integral method for transient analysis of complex conducting objects
abstract: Time domain adaptive integral method (TD-AIM) is presented for transient analysis of electrically large conducting objects. The compressed storage technique of the sparse matrix is used to decrease enormous memory requirements. A temporary file is created in the hard disk that is adopted for the impedance matrix elements' storage of the near interaction components. The simulation result demonstrates the efficacy of this method.

articleTitle: Study on a new sub-wavelength grating for antireflective structure of solar cell
abstract: A new sub-wavelength grating for Anti-Reflective (AR) coating layer of solar cells is proposed in this paper. The reflectivity of this structure is investigated by the Rigorous Coupled Wave Analysis (RCWA) method. Numerical results show that compared with general SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> AR coating layer, the average reflectivity of this new structure has greatly been reduced by 16% and 10.85% under TE and TM modes respectively. And the average reflection rate is less than 6% when the incident wave is working in a range of the wavelength between 400 nm and 1400nm. Good performance of the new structure makes it possible to develop practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on scintillation index of Laser beam propagation through atmospheric turbulence for double slant path
abstract: The modified Rytov theory was applied to study the Laser beam propagating through the atmospheric turbulence under the double slant path. According to the Born approximation and the kolmogorov atmosphere turbulence power spectrum, the general expression of the optical scintillation both on target's plane and on receiver's were given, and further based on the atmospheric structure constant of ITU-R, the characteristic of the optical scintillation index was analyzed with different parameters altitude. The study showed that the characteristic of optical scintillation index on the target's plane and the receiver's have a nearly connection with the characteristic of scattering field except the altitude effect and so on.

articleTitle: Effects of antenna height on detection of Microwave over-the-horizon radar
abstract: Evaporation ducts near sea surface make the Microwave over-the-horizon radars work, however, the shadow zones in detection ranges make it possible for enemy aircrafts to break through the defences without being found. Generally, there are two ways, one is low flying under the shield of sea clutter; the other is through the shadow zone above the ducts. The effects of evaporation duct heights and antenna heights on shadow zone detection are simulated and analysised, based on which the optimum Antenna height on shadow zone detection are analysised. The simulation indicated that Antenna height can deeply effect the detection of Microwave over-the-horizion radar.

articleTitle: Active circuit macro modeling based on rational function
abstract: This paper presents a method for the construction of active circuit's macromodel based on frequency data obtained from an electromagnetic simulation or measurements. This method applies the rational function to the active circuit macro modeling and introduces a correction coefficient to rectify the Spice equivalent circuit macromodel of active circuit. The macromodel of active circuit can improve the efficiency of EMC simulation.

articleTitle: Relevance analysis between harmonic and fundamental frequency in emitting spectrum of active phased array antenna
abstract: Phased array antenna works with wide frequency band and high power, and the harmonic component of its emitting spectrum extremely easily produce electromagnetic interference to other equipments with antenna on the platform. It is necessary to forecast the harmonic coupling in the design stage. Take typical vivaldi active phased array antenna for example. Through analyzing the relevance mechanism of harmonic and fundamental frequency energy, we establish the simulation method of harmonic emitting from phased array antenna. Then the simulated results are compared with the experimental data. The comparison shows that harmonic and fundamental frequency in emitting spectrum of active phased array antenna have relevance, and this relevance can be used to simulate emitting harmonic energy. It has practical application value in electromagnetic compatibility prediction for ships.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of distributed testing system based on Jini technology
abstract: With the using of embedded computer and Windows, Linux, VxWorks and other modern operating systems in a large number of electronic measuring instruments, electronic measuring instruments generally support the current network interface, in order to make the instrument easy to access the network, that is, achieving plug and play for the instrument. In this paper Jini technology is used to build automated test systems, employing JNI to solve the problem of interaction with the third-party development tools. The basic architecture of Jini is briefly introduced with an example, in which LabViEW is used as the client. And the general Jini application development process is discussed. It is shown that the Jini technology enables a distributed automatic test system more robust, flexible, and intelligent.

articleTitle: A method for determining optimal decomposition scale in wavelet threshold de-noising
abstract: While taking wavelet transforms to signal de-noising in signal processing field, determining signal decomposition scale is the key factor for wavelet threshold de-noising. By using the Mallat algorithm to dyadic wavelet decomposition, the sequence length decays with 2 powers to the increase of decomposition. Therefore a method to determine the optimal decomposition scale based on small sample of white noise verification is proposed in this paper. Finally, simulation results indicate that the above method is effective.

articleTitle: Simulation of rain attenuation time series and fade duration statistic
abstract: The rain attenuation time series in Beijing and Hainan are synthesized by the means of E M-B model at microwave band and the fade duration is discussed. The number and probability of fade exceeding a given fade value are calculated based on 50 simulated rain attenuation time series, and compared with ITU-R predictive and measured values at 12.5GHz, in Hainan. The results indicate that the fade duration analysis by means of simulative rain attenuation time series is feasible. According to the rain attenuation time series simulated by E M-B, fade duration statistics are analysed at 20/30 GHz, in Beijing. The results show that in a given threshold value, the higher frequency is, the more numbers of fade are.

articleTitle: Parallel algorithm for the effective electromagnetic properties of heterogeneous materials on 3D RC network model
abstract: In order to study the effective electromagnetic properties of heterogeneous materials, computation of very large 3D RC (resistor-capacitor) network model is indispensable. The huge computations and long time-consuming exist in previous sequential algorithm, which hinder the widely application of the model. A novel parallel algorithm for the model is presented in this paper. Simulation results show that the parallel algorithm greatly reduces the computation time. It's found that the larger the size of the model is, the higher the efficiency of the parallel algorithm is. It is helpful to develop materials with required dielectric properties at radio and microwave frequencies.

articleTitle: Application of hybrid FEM/BIE on electromagnetic scattering from random rough surface: TE case
abstract: In this work, a hybrid method combining the finite element method (FEM) with the boundary integral equation (BIE) is applied to discuss the scattering properties of random rough surfaces. In the region surrounded by the rough surface and the artificial boundary, FEM is used to solve the problem, whereas the artificial boundary condition can be got by BIE. To verify FEM/BIE, the method of moment (MoM) is applied to evaluate the method's validity, and the dependences of different polarizations, incident angles, correlation lengths and root mean square heights on the bistatic scattering coefficients are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Review of Transmission Line Model on EBG structures
abstract: Transmission Line Model (TLM) are well used as a partially or fully analyse method for antennas, including Microstrip Antennas (MSA). The recent appearance of EBG structures focus the interest to improve the electromagnetic characteristics of MSA, therefore the analyses has become more complex even for CAD tools consuming computer resources and time process. TLM had been proving to be a useful tool to estimate the physical dimension of EBG structures as the antenna that carried it.

articleTitle: Comparisons of multi-parameter Bidirectional Reflectance Distributional Function
abstract: Based on the artificial immune network algorithm, five-, six-and seven-parameter BRDF models are compared for different samples in this paper. Both of mean Square Error between the measured data and simulation results and the calculation time of these BRDF models are presented. The scopes of application of each BRDF models are discussed. And this kind of researches may provide help for selection of BRDF models for different samples.

articleTitle: The maximum available frequency prediction of HF communication under a complex environment using the modified IRI and IGRF model
abstract: In this paper, 3D ray tracing algorithm was constructed based on the modified IRI model and IGRF geomagnetic field model. In short-wave detection, it can be used to predict the electromagnetic parameters of the receiving point, such as, the receiving area, maximum available frequency and the distribution of the group delay etc, which can help to determine the suitability of the communication. As an example, we estimated the maximum available frequency around Changchun in the detection from Qingdao to Changchun using the modified IRI and IGRF model, and provided technical support for the communication between the two cities.

articleTitle: Estimation of radiation property of cylindrical array
abstract: In this paper, an efficient calculation approach on radiation pattern of conformal array antenna is presented by using far-field data of antenna element. To demonstrate the computational accuracy of the proposed method, a 16-element cylindrical array antenna is simulated as an example. And the simulated results are compared with those of HFSS. Then the performance of the virtual phase shifting technology for cylindrical array is investigated. Finally, the effects of the attenuation accuracy of attenuator and the bit number of digital phase shifter on the radiation pattern of cylindrical array antenna, including beam granularity and pointing accuracy, are discussed.

articleTitle: Band-pass filter using dual magnetic resonances
abstract: Recently, there has been great interest in using the metamaterial resonators as constituent particles for the design of band-pass and band-reject filters. In this paper, a dual-band band-pass filter using loop split ring resonator with dual magnetic resonances is proposed. The single loop split ring is made of simple conducting strip with winding geometry. Simulated transmission and phase properties predict that there are two magnetic resonances near 8.4GHz and 9.2GHz. Dual bands of negative permeability are verified using the retrieval procedure. Then, the filter is designed by combination with periodically loop split rings and narrow short connecting wires which is based on coplanar waveguide (CPW) structure. The short connecting wires make the structure have negative effective permittivity with broad frequency range. Combined with the negative permeability loop split ring etched on the back of the CPW, two pass bands appear near 8.2GHz and 9.2GHz. Since rings are much smaller than signal wavelength at resonance and can be easily tuned, it has great prospects in application based on left-handed property.

articleTitle: Measurement method for radiation pattern of large HF antenna array
abstract: Two important aspect of measurement method for radiation pattern of large HF antenna array is studied in this paper. The difference of receive mode and emission mode was discussed. The optimal distance for radiation pattern measurement is proposed in varies modes. A comprehensive measure method is proposed.

articleTitle: Absorbing performance of ultrathin wide-band planar metamaterial absorber
abstract: We propose an ultrathin metamaterial absorber based on Minkowski fractal frequency selective surface and resistive films, which shows a wide-band polarization insensitive and wide-angle strong absorption. This absorber consists of Minkowski fractal loop structure electric resonator, dielectric substrate and backing continuous resistive films. The finite element method was used to simulate and analyze the absorption of the metamaterial absorber. The corresponding high absorption mainly originates from the multiband resonance properties of Minkowski fractal loop structure and Ohmic loss properties of resistive films. The further simulated results indicate that surface resistance of resistive films and dielectric constant can affect the absorbing properties of the metamaterial absorber. This absorber maybe applied in many military fields.

articleTitle: The simulation research of manipulating electromagnetic wave polarizations by metamaterial
abstract: A new metamaterial polarization transformer is designed in our paper, which is a sandwich structure. There are three metal layers and two dielectric layers in it. The top and bottom layer is SRR structure, and the middle layer is a metal cross-shape structure. We give the simulated results of this model. It reaches a near-complete cross polarization conversion at 11.03 GHz, and the polarization conversion ratio is 96.6%. Then the internal physical mechanism is analyzed through the current and electric field distribution figures. The enantiomeric pattern and sandwich coupling structure help us to manipulate the electromagnetic wave polarizations. In addition, we load the lumped elements on the gaps of SRRs to control the polarization characteristic. And we find the impact of resistor is very big. Using this feature, we can manipulate the electromagnetic wave polarizations more flexibly.

articleTitle: A quasi three-dimensional subgrid technique for the geodesic FDTD algorithm
abstract: A quasi three-dimensional (3D) subgrid technique for the geodesic finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) algorithm is proposed to increase local resolution level for solving extremely low frequency (ELF) electromagnetic wave propagation problems in the Earth-ionosphere system. Basic idea of this technique is to first split the spherical triangular grid into smaller grids and then split the corresponding spherical hexagonal grid with smaller grids, after that the finite difference technique is applied to these grids to complete the subgrid process. In order to keep long term numerical stable, virtual field quantities are introduced and interpolation is used to calculate them. We have finally given an simulation example to prove correctness of the technique.

articleTitle: A compact triple band printed monopole antenna for WiMAX/WLAN applications
abstract: In this article, a printed monopole antenna for triple band operation is presented. The antenna fed by microstrip structure has a compact size of 33(L)*30(W)*1.6(H) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>; and a simple structure. The proposed antenna design is described. A prototype has been fabricated and tested. The results are presented which indicate that it is suitable for the 2.5-2.69GHz, 3.4-3.69GHz, and 5.23-5.85GHz WiMAX applications and the 2.4-2.484GHz, 5.15-5.35GHz, and 5.725-5.825GHz WLAN applications.

articleTitle: A 3-D conformal MRTD scheme for electromagnetic scattering problems including curved dielectric objects
abstract: In this paper, a new scaling functions integral conformal multiresolution time-domain (SFI-CMRTD) scheme based on Daubechies' wavelets, which utilizes the locally conformal technology and concept of effective dielectric constant (EDC), and needs to integrate the scaling functions, is proposed and applied to solve three-dimensional (3-D) electromagnetic scattering problems containing curved dielectric objects. It is numerically demonstrated that the proposed SFI-CMRTD scheme can reduce the staircase error and effectively solve the invalidation of Maxwell's curl equations on the mutation surfaces of dielectric.

articleTitle: Analysis of the scale conditions for the rough surface
abstract: The basis of scale measurement is that the two electromagnetic systems of model and prototype must satisfy the similar conditions. This paper derives the scale theory which is applied to the scattering of rough surface. To the rough surface, the scale model must be similar to the prototype in geometry. Therefore, the scale conditions for the geometry of 1-D rough surface is also studied, which is prepared for calculating the scattering of rough surface based on the scale models. To compare the scattering characteristics of model and prototype, the RCS of 1-D perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) and dielectric Gaussian rough surface are calculated according to the method of moments (MoM). The numerical results show that the scale conditions for the geometry of rough surface presented in this paper are valid.

articleTitle: Time domain simulation of three dimensional elastic wave scattering
abstract: To simulate elastic wave propagating in different solid medium, a three dimensional model has been developed Based on Yee's algorithm, the staggered grid of the stressvelocity equations for the model has been set up, and the finite-difference form of it has been derived. The perfectly matched layer (PML) absorbing boundary is discussed, and the finite-difference scheme of the PML boundary conditions is implemented. Active simulation of the interaction of elastic wave with layered medium and cubic object has been finished, respectively. Numerical experiments have proved the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on behavioral model of electronic equipments and its application in EMC
abstract: In the design and analysis of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), the technology of establishing of behavioral modelling of the electronic module and equipments is the basis of theoretical analysis. This paper presents a comparison between the most important techniques present to address the behavioral modelling of radio-frequency equipments. The status quo and developmental trend of the behavioral modelling technology is discussed in this paper, on the foundation of which several existent behavioral models are listed and analyzed, and the principles of selecting modelling methods is given. The application of this technology in EMC is discussed at the last of this paper.

articleTitle: Radio fuse echo CEM model based on PO-MoM algorithm
abstract: For the difficulty and low efficiency in calculating the radio fuze echo of complex target with traditional method, the PO-MOM Hybrid computation methodology is introduced to the traditional radio near-field fuze echo computing model. The established model can approximately calculate and quickly access target near-field equivalent RCS with the PO-MOM hybrid algorithm. When combined with the radar equation, the engineering CEM model of target terminal ballistics radio fuze echo signal can be achieved. The result of model validation shows that: the model has a high calculating speed, and the error is less than 25%, so this model can be used in quick simulation of radio fuze echo signal.

articleTitle: Airborne SAR motion compensation and moving target indication
abstract: This paper describes a precise real-time Doppler parameter estimation algorithm, which is based on the estimation of the pitch and yaw angles directly from radar returns. The application of this technique allows using a simple navigation system consisting of a radar altimeter and a GPS receiver only. The pulse compression technique with binary phase coding of transmitted pulses has been used to achieve high range resolution, which reduces requirements to the digital signal processing system and enables the realization of real-time signal processing easily. The radar data acquisition system contains of FPGA and DSP to realize motion compensation for airborne SAR and indication of moving targets. Results of measurement show that the algorithm is valid.

articleTitle: The application of metamaterials with slant H split ring on microstrip antenna
abstract: The discovery of metamaterials brings about a great shock to people's viewpoint about the world. It is of great scientific significance and application prospect. Metamaterials based on slant H split ring is used as the cover of microstrip antenna in this paper. Simulation by Ansoft HFSS shows that the resonance frequency is reduced by 0.07GHz by using metamaterials. At the same time, the gain of the antenna is increased by 1.16dB and the lobe is reduced by 24 degrees.

articleTitle: The damageable effect and corresponding tactics for fighting system under complex electromagnetic environment
abstract: From the composing of the complex electromagnetic environment and the time, frequency, spatial, energy, and polarization domain, the damageable effect of fleet information system and fighting system are analyzed, and then we discuss the degradation, invalidation performance of sensitive electric information system for the sake of the complex electromagnetic environment. We also propose some corresponding tactics against the damageable effect of the information system for ship and the whole fleet, such as the token method of e-fight source environment, behavior-model of energy transfer in front-end of sensitive receiver system, new protection rules, information integration method and combined frequency management. All these method can improve the performance of the ship fleet under complex electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Testing and verifying technique of the performance of tri-band beacon ground application system
abstract: Because the electron density of the Earth's ionosphere varies rapidly, and current detection capability of ground-based remote sensing systems is limited. The inversion accuracy of CIT based on tri-band beacon (TBB) couldn't be verified effectively by current ground-based ionospheric remote sensing systems. In order to realize the testing and verifying requirements of CIT performance based on TBB, which will be loaded on the “China Seismo-Electromagnetic Satellite (CSES)”, this paper presents an effective and reliable method for testing and verifying ionospheric CIT technique based on TBB.

articleTitle: Design of an electromagnetic compatibility testing system used for onsite measurement
abstract: To realize the measurement tasks at locations where equipments are installed, an electromagnetic compatibility testing system is designed. Function and structure of the system are provided. Modules of microwave frequency converter and digital IF processing as well as RF front processing unit are described. Design tips of wideband YTF and switches are provided. Elementary experiments have proved effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: An improved hat-shaped cavity-backed Archimedean spiral antenna
abstract: A novel Archimedean spiral antenna is designed and researched. The antenna is configured with a hat-shaped reflecting cavity and chip-resistor loads to improve the half power beam width and axial ratio. In the paper, the designing methodology and theoretical analysis are presented. The results show that the antenna has the broad beam width that more than 80° and low axial ratio that less than 4dB. They are better than those of traditional abnormal cavity-backed Archimedean spiral antennas. The designed antenna can be used in the ultra-wideband communication system on the mobile carrier.

articleTitle: A dual-polarized microstrip antenna array with low cross-polarization for retrodirective antenna system
abstract: A dual-linearly polarized microstrip antenna array working in the frequency of 2.4GHz is proposed according to the requirements of retrodirective antenna system. As the simulated results shown, both of the cross-polarization levels of the horizontal port and vertical port are lower than −20dB. Both of the horizontal-polarized and vertical-polarized main beams can scan from the angle −45º to +45º. The antenna array meets the requirements of retrodirective antenna system and can be used in other duplex communications.

articleTitle: Simulation of the influence of whitecap on the scattering of sea surfaces at low grazing angles
abstract: It is known to all of us, breaking wave and whitecap can severally affect the radar cross section (RCS) and the Doppler spectrum of sea surfaces, especially at low grazing angles (LGA). Using the slope criterion, this paper simulates the whitecap distribution which is similar with the real situation on the sea surfaces. Radiative transfer theory and Phase-modified Two-scale Method (TSM) are employed to computer the scattering of whitecap and sea surfaces without whitecap, respectively. Considering the Bragg phase velocity and the additional phase velocity of whitecap, the Doppler spectrum of sea surfaces with whitecap is simulated and a good improvement is obtained.

articleTitle: Application of CFIE with hierarchical vector basis functions for EM scattering from hybrid metal-dielectric objects with MLFMA
abstract: A new type of hierarchical high-order vector (HHOV) basis functions (BFs) based on triangular patches were used to analyze electromagnetic (EM) scattering from the complex three-dimensional multilayered dielectric objects, the metallic objects, and their composite in this paper. The HHOV BFs have been used to lower down the computational cost radically. The CFIE-JMCFIE has been applied to simulate scattering from the hybrid metal-dielectric targets with arbitrary shape. Combining with multilevel fast multiple algorithm (MLFMA), the new type of HHOV BFs further reduce the computational complexity and the memory cost evidently. For the case of lossy dielectric object, a modified formula for the mode number (L) is given in this paper. The numerical examples demonstrate that the proposed method can greatly lower down the memory requirements, increase the solution efficiency and acquire reliable results.

articleTitle: Validation of super thermal electron induced by nth gyro-harmonic frequency heating
abstract: When the gyro-harmonic heating and some other instability happen at the same time, several instabilities interact with each other, which is easier for them to ionize neural gas. It is represented as the huge enhancement of the electron density amplitude, and the scale of enhancement will extend to several hundreds kilometers. Base on the observation results of the heating experiment in polar region, the super thermal electron induced by nth gyro-harmonic frequency heating is validated and the relevant physical process is explained.

articleTitle: Research on the fault tolerance in retrieving atmospheric refractivity by microwave radiometer data
abstract: Ground-based microwave radiometer has proven to be a powerful tool to detect the atmosphere. The common algorithms are linear regression, neural network, and relevance vector machine. A fault tolerance evaluation has been considered on the above three algorithms in retrieving atmospheric refractivity. A simulation experiment reveals that the fault tolerance of relevance vector machine is very good, while the other two are worse. To improve the fault tolerance of linear regression and neural network, we can add measurement error to the brightness temperature when training.

articleTitle: Application of weak signal extraction technology in computer video leaking measurement system
abstract: The technology of detection and reconstruction for valid information is a research emphasis in TMPEST, the technology of electromagnetic leaking research. After the research and analysis of computer video leaking in CRT system, the problem of weak signal extraction in receiving part of computer video leaking measurement system is pointed out. The extraction method for horizontal synchronization signals based on the correlation technique and de-noising method for video leaking signals based on the one-dimensional wavelet transform are proposed, which are of great importance in detecting and reconstruction of video leaking signal.

articleTitle: Novel design of dual-band unequal Wilkinson power divider with wide band-ratios and simple layout
abstract: This paper presents the design of an unequal-split Wilkinson power divider operating at arbitrary dual-band without reactive components. Unlike the traditional approaches, a pair of coupled lines is introduced to achieve the dual-band operation. The proposed divider can operate over a wide range of band-ratios. Moreover, the overall structure of power divider can be simplified with small number of transmission line sections using the proposed method. Closed-form equations of the proposed structure are derived based on transmission line theory. For verification, the measured results of a 2:1 power-divider circuits operating at 1 and 2 GHz are given.

articleTitle: Scattering of an arbitrary shaped object by using vectorial complex ray model
abstract: Vectorial complex ray model has been developed to describe the scattering of smooth surface object of arbitrary shape. In this model, the property of a wave — curvature of wavefront is integrated in ray model, such that all waves are described as vectorial complex rays of five parameters: amplitude, phase, direction of propagation, polarization and curvature matrix of its wavefront. At each interaction of a ray with the surface of the object, the ray direction is determined by the vector Snell law, the divergence or convergence of the wave is calculated by the wavefront curvature (WFC) and the phase shift due to focal line is evaluated according to CWF. The total scattered field is the superposition of the complex amplitude of all orders of the rays emergent from the object. Thanks to the simple representation of the wave, this model is very suitable for the description of the interaction of an arbitrary wave with an object of smooth surface and complex shape. The applications of the model to 2D scattering of a plane wave by an infinite elliptical cylinder and a spheroid particle are presented. The particle can be absorbing and its refractive index can also be less than unity.

articleTitle: Miniature omnidirectional planar antenna for wideband vertical polarization applications
abstract: A novel miniature omnidirectional planar antenna for wideband vertical polarization applications is presented in this paper. This paper discusses a miniaturization technique in designing the compact omnidirectional antenna. Two shorting pins technique is applied to a well-know planar antenna structure whose radiation characteristics are similar to equivalent monopole ones. The typical dimension (radius) of the presented antenna is 0.1 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> being the free space operating wavelength) which makes it a miniature antenna that can be integrated inside some portable wireless devices which have strict restriction for the antenna's size using wideband communication systems. The proposed antenna input impedance bandwidth is 20% (720MHz) with respect to the center frequency of f0 GHz. It exhibits good radiation pattern in H-plan with small gain variations (<;0.6dBi).

articleTitle: Computation transient far radiation field of a helical antenna over the half-space using the semi-analytic method
abstract: In this paper, the transient far radiation field of an arbitrarily electric dipole located above the lossy half-space is computed. The directed wave is obtained by analytic method and the reflected wave can be obtained by using the Fourier transform and the inverse Fourier transform with the consideration of time delay and the reflection of the lossy halfspace. Then the far radiation field of the complex antenna can be obtained by using the superposition principle. At last, the transient far radiation field of a helical antenna located above lossy half-space is computed.

articleTitle: Numerical solution of the horn antenna with complex structure
abstract: The integral equation method and the mode matching method has been used as a combined numerical algorithm to simulate the horn antenna with complex structure and electronically large size. The mode matching method is used to depict the excitation and the integral equation method is used to solve the equavalence surface sources. The multilevel fast multipole algorithm(MLFMA) have been used to speed up the matrix-vector multiplication and reduce the memory requirement. The sparse approximate inverse(SAI) preconditioning technique were used to reduce the number of the iteration steps. It has been demonstrated that the method proposed by this paper is able to provide the efficient and accurate numerical solutions for the horn antenna with arbitrary shape and electronically large size.

articleTitle: Modelling of electromagnetic field coupling from ESD EMP to PCB
abstract: Printed circuit board(PCB) designers require fast and accurate methods of simulating immunity of PCB to electrostatic discharge(ESD) events to adequately predict and analyze ESD issues. An efficient methodology for calculating the electromagnetic field coupling from ESD electromagnetic pulse(EMP) to PCB while fully considering the non-linear circuit elements in the PCB core is proposed in this paper. Voltages and currents within the PCB are found by merging full-wave simulations of ESD EMP with a SPICE model of the PCB and the coupled electromagnetic energy. This method was verified through experiments, results show the promise of the method. This hybrid modelling method can significantly accelerate simulation time compared with traditional modelling techniques and can allow the designers to explore the variation in coupling that occurs with small changes in the test setup better, such as the position and orientation of the EMP and PCB pins.

articleTitle: A coaxial line based propagation channel for wireless communication between rotating machine components
abstract: A communication system of microwave signals between non-contacted inside and outside components of a machine tool is presented for special monitoring purpose. General problems such as load matching, power transmission efficiency and product feasibility must be considered for the design of such a system. In this paper, the design difficulties caused by restrictions of the size and discontinuity of the structures are discussed and a solution based on coaxial line is carried out. A total transmission loss less than 3 dB is achieved by implementing the concept for the given machine component in this paper and the obtained solution can be carried out with low production cost and is thus suited for mass production. The general idea and the theoretical design concepts can also be employed for other manufacturing technological processes with similar motivation, such as sensing and controlling applications.

articleTitle: SAR modeling and simulation of complex extended scenes
abstract: Traditional SAR simulation is based on Point Scattering Model (PSM), in which the physical process of electromagnetic (EM) scattering is simplified and the effects of multiple-path, anisotropy and frequency dependence are often ignored. In this paper, a novel SAR simulation method based 3-D scene with facet model and propagation and scattering of EM wave is proposed. The method utilizes high-frequency EM scattering theory and ray tracing technique to compute the received field at each azimuth location and each discrete transmitted frequency, which is recorded and then processed to SAR image, and also can be transformed to SAR raw signal if necessary. Compared with other methods, the proposed method is valuable not only for SAR system design and imaging algorithm validation, but also for the research of SAR imaging characteristics and target recognition.

articleTitle: Simulation of WEM using ELF modeling of local area and modified UPML
abstract: The wireless electromagnetic method (WEM) is an electromagnetic detection technology using extremely low frequency wave to detect underground resources and predict earthquakes. This paper studied the propagation of extremely low frequency (ELF) electromagnetic (EM) wave in real-geographic space. We used modified finite difference timedomain (FDTD) method to model part of the Earth and modified uniaxial perfectly matched layer (UPML) as the absorbing boundary, then applied this model to simulate the WEM. The results of wave propagation in the underground show several wave propagation properties, which can be applied in future WEM application studies. It is noted that real-geodesic data are included to improve the practicability of the simulation results.

articleTitle: A fast ray-tracing algorithm for microcellular propagation prediction models
abstract: An idea of virtual source and multiway tree is introduced to present a new and very fast ray-tracing method, which is based on uniform geometrical theory of diffraction (UTD) and can solve some of the problems that other ray-tracing methods have. It is developed for quasi three-dimensional (3-D) environments and can be applied to any complex propagation environment composed of arbitrary-shaped buildings and streets. The useless node is released timely because constructing multiway tree and finding propagation path is synchronized. It is fundamentally a point-to-point tracing method, so reception tests are not required and it guarantees high accuracy.

articleTitle: On the radiation near-field computational model of phased array antenna based on mutual impedance
abstract: This paper presents a novel radiation near-field computational model of phased array antenna based on mutual impedance. The steps are included: antenna element port current evaluation based on mutual impedance of array antenna element, resolving of radiation lobe of element, superimposition of fields. The novel method is fast and practical.

articleTitle: Application of physical optics for scattering calculation in MMWSS
abstract: In this paper, the physical optical (PO) method is employed to calculate the electromagnetic field distribution on the seeker antenna when the missile approaches the target. Compared with the result calculated in the millimeter wave simulation system (MMWSS), it can be equivalent to one or more scattering points when the target is located in the far-field of antenna.

articleTitle: Design of a novel antenna element for BGAN phased array antenna system
abstract: A novel antenna element has been proposed for maritime satellite communication Broadband Global Area Network (BGAN) phased array antenna system. The proposed antenna element is composed of a square radiating patch, two vertical trapezoidal coupling strips and a T-junction power splitter feeding network. A dual orthogonal side coupled feeding technique has been adopted to realize a circularly polarized square patch antenna. Design concepts and procedures are introduced, followed by simulations and discussions. Good antenna characteristics are achieved in the entire BGAN working band, having input impedance match characteristics of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub><;-15dB, antenna gain higher than 7dBi, and the axial ratio lower than 4dB.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering from a PEC cylinder above two-layered rough surface: Horizontal polarization
abstract: The Method of Moment (MoM) is introduced to calculate the bistatic scattering efficient (BSC) of a stack of two one-dimensional Gaussian rough surface with a perfectly electric conducting (PEC) object for horizontal polarization. The two rough surface separate three lossless and homogeneous media. A cylinder was located above the two layered surface. The efficiency of this work is derived by comparing with the existing models, which are special cases that include a PEC object located above a single-layered rough surface and single-layered rough surface only without an object.

articleTitle: Coupled-mode analysis of two-parallel photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: A coupled-mode formulation for two-parallel photonic crystal waveguides is discussed. Using a perturbation theory, the self-contained first-order coupled-mode equations are presented, which govern the evolution of the amplitudes of the eigenmodes of individual photonic crystal waveguides in isolation.

articleTitle: Research on the equivalent radiation power test methods
abstract: Based on the dual-path propagation model comparison and absolute method, we analysis the test error of the equivalent radiation power. And the appropriate test distance used to reduce measurement error caused by the surface reflection is extracted.

articleTitle: Active low noise differentially fed dipole antenna
abstract: An active antenna based on a printed dipole directly connected to a differential amplifier is presented. The antenna covers the frequency band from 1.7-2.6GHz meaning the relative bandwidth of 41.86%. As the input impedance is mainly defined by the amplifier output, S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> <; -10dB was obtained in the whole frequency range. By designing both the active and the passive parts together a low equivalent noise temperature of 169K was obtained. The gain of the active antenna is higher than 15dBi. Antenna prototype was manufactured and measured. A good agreement between simulation and measurement was observed.

articleTitle: Analysis of dielectric-covered waveguide longitudinal slots
abstract: A robust approach to analysis the dielectric-covered waveguide longitudinal slot on the basis of M-M's method is proposed. The new approach takes full advantages of the three-level GPOF, which can give accurate evaluation even without rigorous investigation of the spectral-domain behavior of the Green's functions in advance. Moreover, the SWP extraction and the changes of variables needn't be done any more. Thus, it is quite robust and very suitable for the development of CAD tools. The proposed approach has been validated by the simulation and experiment data taken from previous publications, and also by a commercial finite-element software HFSS.

articleTitle: Wide stopband bandpass filter based on DGS slot structure
abstract: A novel bandpass filter with excellent harmonic suppression performance based on dual-plane defected ground structure (DGS) is proposed. The DGS slot structure consists of two folded square loop slots and two J-shaped slots. Using this structure, the filter has a good selectivity and exhibits a wide upper stopband characteristic. The equivalent circuit is also presented in this letter. Measured results show that the filter centred at 1.575 GHz has a fractional bandwidth of about 9.2%. The attenuation is below 20 dB over a wide band from 2.2 to 20 GHz.

articleTitle: River traffic monitoring with UHF passive bistatic radar in clutter-rich environment
abstract: Passive bistatic radar (PBR) systems, which using existing commercial signals as the illuminators of opportunity, is an emerging technology in new radar systems. In this paper we investigate the feasibility of using PBR for ship detection. The challenges caused by the complex propagation environment are first described. Then corresponding techniques are introduced to handle these problems. Preliminary experiment results using CMMB-based PBR are discussed, demonstrating the potential and prospects of using UHF PBR for river traffic control.

articleTitle: The analysis of relationships between EMI and EMC indicators based on super network
abstract: A super network was built in this paper to describe the interconnections between electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) indicators. And EMI network was divided into three clusters according to the basic components of EMI. Then some features of the super network were analysed to character the relationships among indicators and nodes of EMI network, which will support the EMC predesign of the electronic system.

articleTitle: Zero-forcing beam-forming and iterarive detection algorithm for multiuser Turbo-BLAST system
abstract: The zero-forcing beam-forming algorithm is proposed and the modified iterative detector is presented for the downlink multiuser Turbo-BLAST system in this paper. At the transmitter, the beam-forming scheme based on zero-forcing rule is adopted to maximize the capacity of the desired user. At the receiver, the pretreatment matrix is used to mitigate the multiuser interference (MUI) and the iterative detecting algorithm is designed to cancel the co-antenna interference (CAI). Simulation results show that the newly introduced method is effective to enhance not only the capacity results but also the BER performance of the downlink multiuser Turbo-BLAST system.

articleTitle: Fast computation of RCS from electrically large 3-D homogeneous objects
abstract: Based on the combined tangential formulation (CTF) of surface integral equation, the lower triangular approximate Schur preconditioner (LTASP) is combined with multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) for MoM analysis of electromagnetic scattering from electrically large 3-D homogeneous objects. The coefficient matrix of the near-field coupling element was selected to set up the approximate matrix, and both sparse approximate inverse (SAI) and dual threshold incomplete LU factorization (ILUT) are used for constructing the preconditioner to accelerate the convergence of GMRES iteration. Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the performance of the proposed preconditioner. A scattering problem of dielectric sphere with the diameter of 40 wavelengths and dielectric constant of 4.0 has been solved successfully.

articleTitle: Estimation of DOA and polarization parameters based on polarized UCA
abstract: Based on a polarized uniform circular array(UCA), estimation of direction of arrival(DOA) and polarization is studied. The phase ambiguity of existing algorithm is analysed. According to the characteristics of array manifold vector, the embattle conditions is corrected. Using the array manifold vector relationship between electric dipoles and magnetic dipoles, the least squares solution to the signal polarization parameters and DOA is given. Without spectral peak searching and parameter matching, this method has advantages of the small amount of calculation and high precision. Finally, Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The assessment of electromagnetic radiation to electronic equipment in Civil Aviation Building
abstract: This passage is to assess the electromagnetic sensitive characteristics of the electronic equipment in Civil Aviation Building. The effects of electromagnetic radiation are from the internal radiation of subway station and the surroundings. Thus, we need to measure for the subway station firstly. Then, through the measurement of environment in Civil Aviation Building, we get the environmental level of the building before the establishment of the subway station. By means of HFSS and calculation, the distribution of electromagnetic field reaching the ground from the station can be obtained. Adding what we get to the original environmental level is the total distribution of electromagnetic field. Finally, we compare the results with the sensitivity limits and analyze the potential interference.

articleTitle: Research of VLF communication frequency optimizing method
abstract: The effect of VLF communication is impacted by the environment factors, so the effect lacks the uniformity in the region of time, space and frequency. It makes use of the well prediction of the VLF frequency band, to establish the signal field predicting model and atmospheric noise statistics predicting model respectively, predicts the field of signal and noise level, and then calculated the signal-to-noise ratio. According to the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution we can determine the relationship of the optimal communication frequency, time and location of receiver. So the efficiency of submarine communication can be enhanced.

articleTitle: Iterative doubly constrained robust capon beamformer using adaptive uncertainty level
abstract: In recent years, some iterative robust beamforming (RAB) algorithms using a fixed adaptive uncertainty level (Fu-IRAB) are proposed to overcome the SINR performance deterioration of the conventional RAB methods in the presence of large array steering vector (ASV) errors. However, more iteration steps are consumed before the actual steering vector is reached. This paper introduces a new adaptive beamformer based on the traditional DCRCB (doubly constrained robust capon beamformer using adaptive uncertainty level), by means of updating the uncertainty level adaptively that is proportional to the amount of the mismatch in each step, resulting in a faster convergence rate in comparison with the Fu-IRAB. In addition, a new robustness is provided to against the initial uncertainty level in the first iteration.

articleTitle: Near-field interpolation scheme for generating VIE-MoM/MLFMA matrices in frequency sweeps
abstract: For fast analysis of broadband electromagnetic (EM) characteristics of dielectric object, a near-field matrix polynomial interpolation scheme is applied into the method of moments based on the volume integral equation combining with multilayer fast multipole algorithm (VIE-MoM/MLFMA). The polynomial interpolation functions based on Lagrange interpolation polynomial and Chebyshev polynomial are investigated and constructed for fast generating the near-field matrices in frequency sweeps. Interpolation results are compared with the values directly obtained from the volume integration. Numerical results show that the near-field impedance matrix interpolation method has more advantage in regard to reducing the computation time while maintaining the same computational accuracy.

articleTitle: IPRM algorithm employed to remove Gibbs phenomenon in F-PSTD
abstract: The Inverse Polynomial Reconstruction Method (IPRM) is employed to perform post-processing to removed possible Gibbs phenomenon in Fourier pseudo-spectral timedomain (F-PSTD) simulation. Compared with the Gegenbauer reconstruction, the IPRM is preferable for its simplicity and accuracy in reconstruction. Thus the IPRM is employed to do post-processing on F-PSTD fields for the first time so far as we know. The results are compared with those of finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) with the same settings, and a good coincidence is found. This shows the feasibility, simplicity and accuracy to use IPRM to do post-processing of fields by F-PSTD.

articleTitle: The sampling error calibration and imaging of synthetic aperture digital radiometer
abstract: The synthetic aperture digital radiometer (SADR) is a new type of passive remote sensing instrument that can reach high spatial resolution. The phase coherence is essential to image of SADR. The sampling error of digital radiometer will affect the correlation, result in imaging sensitivity degraded. This paper analyzes the effect on image sensitivity of SADR by sampling error of multi-channel digital radiometer. The adapted sampling error calibration method is proposed to reduce sampling error and improve the imaging sensitivity. The result of simulation measurement and bright temperature by experiment shows that sampling error calibration can inprove the imaging quality of SADR.

articleTitle: Strict formulas of angular glint linear deviation of complex target with polarization consideration
abstract: The completely integral formulas of scattering fields by complex target in the far-zone with polarization consideration is presented, and based on which, strict formulas of linear deviations of angular glint is derived by using the Poynting vector method. Linear deviations formulas presented include two parts that are ignored in the existing formulas. To investigate the influence of the ignored parts, numerical computation is preformed and the results prove that the ignored parts are so large in some cases and should be considered in the analysis of angular glint.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of aircraft electromagnetic environment
abstract: The spacecraft's electronics and electrical systems is very complex, which includs the control system, telemetry system, measurement system, security system and so on, the interference inside and outside system is very serious. If lacks of careful consideration and appropriate measurement, it will cause poor system performance, even lead to the launch failure. This paper established models of aircraft and typical antennas on aircraft, compared the performance of the same antenna in HFSS and FEKO, and simulated the electromagnetic environment on the aircraft when all the he antennas were at work. The results of electromagnetic environment can offer a reference whether it would affect other electronic equipment.

articleTitle: A DDM-SVE-BI for solving scattering of multiple conducting bodies coated by thin layer dielectric
abstract: A domain decomposition (DD) method for hybrid shell vector element method - boundary integral (SVE-BI) is proposed for analysis of electromagnetic problem of multiple thin-coating objects. By this method, the whole computational domains are divided into sub-SVE-domains and boundary element domains. With shell element, not only the unknowns are far less than the one by traditional vector element method, but only surface integral is required. The DDM-SVE-BI is efficiency for solving multiple coating objects scattering problem. Finally, several numerical examples are presented to prove the accuracy and efficiency of this method.

articleTitle: Wide angle shaped array optimization including mutual coupling
abstract: A hybrid method of genetic algorithm (GA) with method of moments (MoM) is presented in this paper to realize the wide angle shaped pattern taking the mutual coupling into account. The numerical experiment of a 30-element linear array is presented to validate the method. The results of these two methods agree well in the shaped region. With this method to optimize the excitation, the shaped region of the array pattern reaches nearly 45°, and the targets of the maximum ripple less than 2.0 dBi and the sidelobe level less than -25.0dBi are also obtained.

articleTitle: A new full-duplex multi-channel wireless speech synthesis technology
abstract: By analyzing the characteristics of full-duplex multichannel wireless audio communication technology, this paper presents a new technology about multi-channel wireless speech synthesis. In every wireless data packaging cycle, this technology requires up to four Wireless Digital Audio Communication (WDAC) Terminal Devices (TD) to send compressed wireless audio data and the receivers synthesize the received data according to current wireless status. In addition, this paper demonstrates a WDAC system which is designed based on the principle. In this system, it can include unlimited number of TDs, and realize the full-duplex multi-channel Wireless Speech Synthesis Technology.

articleTitle: A novel simulator for correlated generalized-K composite fading channels
abstract: A new simulator for correlated generalized-K (GK) composite fading channels was proposed, which is helpful on performance analysis of communication over this fading channels. It models the correlated GK fading channels by a series of Gamma random fadings with prespecified correlation matrix, which can be generated by well-established methods easily. The simulation results show that the new simulator has a good agreement with the theoretical one on fading envelope distribution and correlation characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on the dust particles parameter with rocket detection in Earth's mesopause
abstract: A simple method to confirm the dust charge number and the radius of dust particles in dusty plasma is deduced. Based on the orbit-limited motion method and the charging theory of dust particles in dusty plasma, the equation of dust particles charging is formed, and the formula of the ratio of dust charge number to the radius of dust particles is deduced. Based on the data of MD-06 campaign, the ratio of dust charge number to the radius of dust particles at occurring polar mesosphere summer echoes(PMSE) is analyzed. The dust charge number and the radius of dust particles are obtained. The results show that the average charge number of dust particles in the polar mesopause is less than one and the average radius of dust particles is about 20nm.

articleTitle: Development and application of electromagnetic computing software based on the FDTD algorithm
abstract: Based on Finite-Difference Time-Domain algorithm, a software calculate the electromagnetic scattering is designed. This software introduce a mixed programming method with Visual C++ & Fortran in the two compile-environment of MS Visual Studio 2008 and Intel Visual Fortran. The interface of the software is designed by VC++, the main calculation program is developed by Fortran. VC++ is used to call the dynamic link library built by Fortran. Examples show that the software has high calculated efficiency, it enhance the human computer interaction and the operability. At the same time, the feasibility, practicability of the mixed programming method are validated.

articleTitle: An exact method to determine the value of inductor on a short off-center-loaded dipole
abstract: An accurate method is put forward to determine the value of inductor loaded on a short off-center loaded dipole. The method treats an antenna under optimization as a multiport system. By tuning several of its ports with lump load, the antenna's performance at a specific frequency can be ameliorated. In order to acquire an accurate impedance matrix, the traditional method of moments is improved by introducing a more smooth basic function, Gauss-Legendre quadrature and extended integral kernel. Considering the impedance matching network, a new principle for easy matching has been set. The new method was verified by the fabricated four short dipoles, resonated at 30 MHz, 35 MHz, 40 MHz and 45 MHz respectively. Because of its simplicity, the method is very time efficient.

articleTitle: Study on reduced-rand algorithms for space-time in GPS receiver
abstract: The principle problem about space-time adaptive anti-jam of GPS receiver system is the high computation complexity. In order to reduce computation complexity, a new algorithm about Correlation Subtraction Architecture of the Multistage Wiener Filter (CSA-MWF) is proposed, which is no need to solve the block matrices. In this paper, a new implementing algorithm for CSA-MWF which needs a lower computation complexity is proposed, while keeping almost the same performance as the original CSA. The simulation results show the proposed algorithm can effectively filter almost all kinds of interference, which prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Slow time random phase-coded waveforms in MIMO OTHR
abstract: With multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technique, skywave over-the-horizon radar (OTHR) is able to implement transmit adaptive digital beamforming (TADBF) to suppress multipath clutter or interference, which is a key technique in next generation OTHR. Time-staggered linear frequency modulated continuous wave and Doppler offset waveforms have been proposed in MIMO OTHR. However, both of the waveforms are constrained by Doppler ambiguity. To solve the problem, a slow time random phase-coded (STRPC) waveforms set fit for both maritime and aircraft surveillance in MIMO OTHR is proposed. And to detect weak targets submerged by cross- correlation peaks caused by strong clutters or large targets, a hierarchical waveform separation (HWS) is proposed. Simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of STRPC waveforms and HWS.

articleTitle: An effective precondition technology for RCS accurate computational engineering of aircrafts
abstract: A precondition method without additional memory is presented to reduce the iterations and improve solving efficiency when accurate method is used to calculate the RCS of aircrafts. By utilizing the feature of near groups impedance matrix is sparse in MLFMA, the near groups impedance matrix is divided into the one with the same father and others with different father. The inverse matrix of the impedance matrix with the same father is used as the precondition matrix in parallel MLFMA to reduce iteration numbers, accelerate the convergence. The numerical results show that the presented method can significant reduce the iterations and converge rapidly. The method is practical in the RCS accurate computational engineering of aircrafts.

articleTitle: Characterization of the planar comb-shaped monopole antenna
abstract: To obtain the lower profile antenna in the L-band frequency, some characteristics of a planar comb-shaped monopole antenna have been discussed in this paper. The relationship between the vertical length of the printed trace and the electrical parameters of the comb-shaped antenna is studied. Changing the vertical length of the printed trace, different values of the substrate dielectric constant, the width, and thickness of the slab, we examine these influences on both resonant frequency and input impedance. Empirical design equations for the resonant frequencies and impedance of the comb-shaped antenna are provided.

articleTitle: A new calibration technique for ground-based microwave radiometer
abstract: A new calibration method for ground-based radiometer is proposed herein. In this method, the relationship between atmosphere opacity and viewing angle is used as a constraint for deriving the system calibration response. The brightness temperatures have been compared that calculated with the absorption model of Liebe's MPM and measured by the QWF-2 radiometer. The results have been improved very much by the tip curve calibration.

articleTitle: Near-field error correction on RFSS for applications
abstract: According to the applications for current RFSS(Radio Frequency Simulation System) developing, this paper proposes a near-field error correction method using mono-pulse amplitude comparison. This method produces two tables which are used to correct near-field error by adjusting the amplitudes on triad of antenna from the gradation direction to make the error of DOA(Direction-Of-Arrival) approaching zero. Meanwhile, this method focuses on the model of mono-pulse amplitude-comparison for seeker setting with a circular slot array of wave guide. Based on the character of symmetry for the slot array, the process of forming the SUM signal and MINUS signal is simplified. The precision of the tables for near-field error correction by our method satisfies the demands of RFSS with the deflection of 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> degree for azimuth and 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> degree for elevation. The simplified method also meets the demand of RFSS and reduces the running time by 55%.

articleTitle: Design of a compact dual band antenna for Bluetooth and UWB application
abstract: A compact and planar dual band antenna for Bluetooth and ultra-wideband (UWB) application is presented. The antenna exhibits a dual band operation covering Bluetooth (2.4–2.484 GHz) and UWB (3.1–10.6 GHz) frequency bands. It is composed of a semi-bevelled-rectangle patch and an L-shaped strip and fed by a microstrip line. The antenna is built on a FR4 substrate with only 21×40 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> surface area. Details of the antenna design and measured results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Influence of developing velocity of lightning leader on the electric field distribution
abstract: Developing velocity of lightning leader is not considered in general case when the electromagnetic field around is calculated. But in the last step of the main lightning discharge stage, the speed of discharge is close to light velocity, so leader speed can not be ignored. In this article, electromagnetic field distribution around leader can be obtained by using Lorentz transformation. The result shows that field strength decreases with the increasing of the developing velocity of lightning leader, and field strength near the leader decreases faster than the further space. With the increasing of leader velocity, the scope of lightning may expand, which may provide a theoretical basis for the analysis of lighting selectivity.

articleTitle: C-band broadband dipole antenna
abstract: A semi sphere loaded reversed conical antenna is designed, which is designed as dielectric embedded antenna and sleeve antenna. The bandwidth of first antenna is 770MHz while the VSWR is less than 1.5. Then the sleeve antenna is designed in order to extend the bandwidth. At last, the simulation result shows the bandwidth could be 2.925GHz while the VSWR is less than 1.5, which means the relative bandwidth is about 48.8%.

articleTitle: Compare of polar ionosphere modification effect with different heating modes
abstract: The measured data in polar winter ionosphere heating experiment carried out at Tromso on 24 November 2011 are analyzed here to find out whether the heating modes of O-mode and X-mode have different influences on electron temperature and electron density and what the influences are. It shows that the enhancement of electron temperature under O-mode is more than that under X-mode. Comparing with the O-mode case, the electron density enhance at higher altitudes under X-mode. The results show that the electron temperature can enhance up to 277% maximum and the electron density can enhance up to 53.7% maximum under O-mode, while the data are 71.8% and 54.8% separately under the X-mode.

articleTitle: The new definition of the asymmetric factor of asymmetric coplanar waveguide
abstract: A new definition of an asymmetric factor of ACPW is proposed, based on the characteristic impedance ratio. The relation between this factor and characteristic impedance of ACPW is derived. This factor has clear physical meanings and easy applications.

articleTitle: A 3-D precorrected FFT algorithm for electrically large objects in planarly layered media
abstract: A three-dimensional (3D) pre-corrected fast Fourier transform (pFFT) is presented for the fast analysis of electromagnetic (EM) scattering from electrically large perfect electrically conducting structures embedded inside a planarly layered medium. The mixed-potential integral equation (MPIE) is used to formulate the problem and the method of moments (MOM) with Rao-Wilton-Glisson (RWG) basis function is employed to solve the integral equation. In order to avoid direct numerical computation of Sommerfeld integrals (SIs), the two-level discrete complex image method (DCIM) is employed to expedite the matrix filling process. In the iterative stage, the pFFT method is further adopted to accelerate the matrix-vector product, since the resulting matrix contains both cyclic convolution and correlation terms after proper splitting. Moreover, the incomplete LU preconditioner is applied to improve the convergence of the matrix equation. Numerical results are presented to show the efficiency and capability of the method.
